purpose: UI/UX exploration requested by the user; proposals only, not implemented or accepted product decisions.
basis: Fresh offscreen renders of the current production Compose components with synthetic fixtures; not native-window screenshots.

concepts.name: 01-summary
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create a polished, realistic, high-fidelity desktop screenshot concept for Mini-Orca, a local-first coding assistant, evolved directly from these reference screenshots. Image 1 is the CURRENT actual app shell reference: keep the same 48px icon-only activity rail, app header, project dropdown, branch, search, separate daemon indicator and bottom model counts. Image 2 is the CURRENT actual Summary content to redesign. These are reference images, not pixel-preserving edit targets. Deliver one landscape 1600x1000 or same 8:5 aspect ratio image, crisp straight-on software UI, no physical device, no perspective, no marketing scene.
Concept 01: a calmer, scannable Summary. Keep the dark developer-tool identity and exact palette: outer chrome #14161A, editor #1B1E23, surfaces #24282F, headers #303640, blue #73ABFF, cyan #66DBEB, green #74E0AC, amber #FFD078. Inter-like clear UI type, 4px rhythm, 10px controls, 14px surface corners, restrained separators. Content should comfortably fill screen with purposeful whitespace, not giant cards or tiny illegible text.
App top: Mini-Orca | go-shop | main | Search files, symbols, commands | Analysis outdated | Daemon connected. Bottom right "Models: 1 local · 2 cloud". Keep 6 rail icons, Summary selected. Workspace header "Summary" and tiny muted "Concept 01 · Example data".
Improve current Summary by separating orientation, coverage, findings and interpretation:
- One plain top project introduction "go-shop" with one line "Go service with a small HTTP API and a repository layer." Quiet metadata line "Go · go.mod · 23 indexed files · 1,800 lines".
- A wide compact horizontal coverage section title "Analysis coverage", visible amber status "Needs attention". Text "16 up to date · 4 outdated · 3 not analyzed" above a clear thin segmented bar, legend labels under it. At right a restrained "View analysis" action; clicking would only navigate. Do not put a model-running control here.
- Next three equally sized compact category surfaces WITH persistent text labels "Bugs", "Performance", "Security", never icon-only. Illustrative consistent content: Bugs "4" with "2 tool-reported · 2 AI suggestions"; Performance "2" with "AI suggestions · Unverified"; Security "—" with "Not analyzed". These are example data only. No invented safety verdict or score.
- Remaining main content in two columns: wider left "Architecture" with short explanatory prose "HTTP handlers validate requests and delegate persistence to repository adapters." and collapsed "Show diagram" button, followed by "Packages / modules" as two flat rows "API handlers" / "internal/api" / "Receives requests." and "Repository adapters" / "internal/storage" / "Persists records."
- narrower right "Engineering insight" with "Validate at the request boundary." and concise supporting sentence "Keep invalid input out of the repository.", and collapsed "Flows" section with "Show diagram".
Maintain readable type, thin separators, no repeated card headers, no charts of invented scores, no code editor or file tree in Summary. Proposed layout and labels are the deliverable. No arrows or annotations outside the app, no big branding, no glow. Clearly make this recognizable as the same app.

concepts.name: 02-analysis
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create a realistic high-fidelity desktop UI screenshot concept for Mini-Orca, evolved from the current actual app in the reference images. Image 1: current shell to retain; image 2: current analysis page to improve. Reference images only; redesign the content, keep identity. One landscape 1600x1000 or same 8:5 aspect ratio, very crisp readable flat UI, no perspective/device/marketing.
Concept 02: analysis progress that is immediately understandable. Same app dark palette: #14161A outer chrome, #1B1E23 main canvas, #24282F surfaces, #303640 headers, #73ABFF primary, #66DBEB running, #74E0AC passed, #FFD078 caution. 48px icon-only rail with 6 icons and Analysis selected. Realistic clear Inter-style font, restrained borders, 10px controls, 14px panel corners, no stacked decorative cards.
Top bar "Mini-Orca | go-shop | main", search "Search files, symbols, commands", separate statuses "Analysis running" and "Daemon connected". Footer right "Models: 1 local · 2 cloud". Main workspace label "Analysis"; small muted "Concept 02 · Example data".
Show a RUNNING example:
- First horizontal progress region: "Analyzing selected files" at left and "Pause" and secondary outlined "Cancel" at right. Clearly show "8 of 12 files complete" and a 2/3 width progress bar. Small factual line "Current: internal/api/user.go". No estimated completion time.
- A row of three compact category cards, each persistently named with icon AND text. "Bugs" with a large em dash, cyan "Running", and "8 covered · 4 remaining". "Performance" likewise em dash, "Running", "8 covered · 4 remaining". "Security" likewise em dash, "Running", "8 covered · 4 remaining". An em dash means finding count not yet available; never make it zero.
- Under these a flat expanded "Files" section with scope text "12 selected · 3 excluded"; small clear note "Selection locked while analysis is running." A search field "Filter files" and compact filters "All", "Needs attention", "Excluded". Search and filtering are local; no unlocked selection checkboxes or selection-changing buttons in this running state.
- A readable aligned table with columns "File", "Analysis state", "Details". 7 visible sample rows:
cmd/server/main.go — Up to date — Complete
internal/api/routes.go — Up to date — Complete
internal/api/user.go — Running — Semantic analysis
internal/db/store.go — Pending — Queued
internal/models/user.go — Pending — Queued
internal/service/service.go — Pending — Queued
vendor/example.go — Excluded — Project configuration
Use a path glyph, subtle row separators, labeled status with colored dots, emphasize current running row with blue-tinted selection. Table should use most middle/lower content area, not large empty cards. Do not imply table lists all 15 files; footer "Showing 7 of 15 files".
Prioritize hierarchy, visibility of exact active file, truthful unknown counts and readable states. Keep semantics of Pause/Cancel. No new features such as budgets, run limits, durations, auto-fix, chat or model settings. No external annotations.
